SOURCE: one table row, read twice (columns: Name of state | Hanzi | Family | Present location | Title | Start and end year | Conqueror). The list calls the state Liu (Lu); the chu dossier calls it Lù (六). Not Lu 魯 (slug lu): the Chu page's separate row '249 BC Lu' is the Shandong state, and the Chu page does not say whether the two are one. SLUG liu-lu-an; ea-01-a suggested lu-2. The disc and the capital dot are the researcher's reading of the county or town named in the row (coordinates, since the gazetteer lacks most of these places). AREA: none.
